theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Match Your Goals With Investing Time Horizons
body: Different life goals need different strategies. Education, retirement, home, wedding—each has unique timelines requiring tailored approaches.
caption: Every major life milestone deserves intentional planning. The sooner you align your goals with appropriate investment timelines, the better positioned you become. Start today, plan wisely, invest systematically. #GoalBasedInvesting #LifeMilestones #InvestingForFuture #SmartPlanning #WealthBuilding
